data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Couch fine, customer service terrible](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69f894485b2eaafdb4a3f058)
Couch and delivery are fine so far, so I guess they get 2 stars, but it’s may and I ordered this couch in November with a 4-6 week lead time, so we are months late. Lulu and Georgia have zero customer service accountability. There is no phone number to call, only email. This way they can be so sorry and get a new date “from the supplier” that’s another 3-4 weeks out. Eventually, my wife started pushing back consistently and showing a lot of anger (over email, still), and the couch magically showed up a week later.

April 22, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 4, 2026

Hi Chet,

Thank you for your feedback—we’re sorry to hear about the delay with your couch delivery and understand how frustrating that must be.

We also appreciate your comments regarding communication. In addition to email, we do offer chat support Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm, as well as a text option for assistance.

We’re actively working on improving both our communication and delivery timelines, and your feedback is valuable in helping us do that.

—Lulu and Georgia
